_comment: Android App Links verification file. Deploy at https://groceryapp.app/.well-known/assetlinks.json (Content-Type application/json) so android:autoVerify links (groceryapp://invite / https://groceryapp.app/invite) open the app without a chooser. Replace the sha256_cert_fingerprints value with the SHA-256 fingerprint of your UPLOAD/signing certificate. If you use Google Play App Signing (recommended), copy the fingerprint Play generates (Play Console → Setup → App integrity → App signing key certificate). For a local keystore: keytool -list -v -keystore stophop-upload.keystore -alias stophop-upload | grep SHA256.
